newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Zeitler says May M3 data not a concern.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Zeitler says May M3 data not a concern.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Franz-Christoph Zeitler said on Monday that German M3 money supply data for May released last week were no cause for concern.
Zeitler said he still saw M3, a key Bundesbank policy indicator, reaching the central bank's target zone of 3.5 to 6.5 percent for 1997.
"I do not see any reason to worry about the latest M3 data," Zeitler told reporters at a trade and investment seminar.
